name: praxis
description: An autonomous engineering operating system for coding agents: kernel routing, process playbooks, artifacts, runtime coordination, worktrees, execution, review, verification, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: An autonomous engineering OS for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis is an autonomous operating system for agentic software work. Its kernel diagnoses the work, chooses the lightest safe process, routes to one current driver, and coordinates task playbooks, durable artifacts, runtime coordination, documentation, agent guidance, lifecycle state, worktree isolation, execution, review, verification, and delivery. Praxis defaults local artifacts, runtime state, and worktrees to .agents/ while respecting repository conventions such as Linear, GitHub issues, or committed documentation.
defaultPrompt: Use praxis:kernel for this engineering task.
Let's plan and build this with Praxis.
Use Praxis to continue this work.
